about.what: Per-country subscription prices for 5 MENA countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Qatar, Kuwait), checked by hand-run scripts on official pricing pages and App Store In-App Purchase lists. Same format as docs/research/prices-2026-11.json.
about.amounts: amountMinor is in the currency's minor unit (fils for AED, halalas for SAR, piastres for EGP, dirhams for QAR, cents for USD). 1999 = 19.99. KWD would be in fils with 3 decimals (1.500 KWD = 1500), but no row uses KWD: every service we checked bills Kuwait in US dollars, so Kuwait rows have currency USD. Netflix and PlayStation also bill Qatar in US dollars. Prices are the regular price after any free trial or intro offer.

status.verified: Read today from the official page in 'source'.
status.partial: Some plans read from the official page; others missing (see note).
status.unverified: Read from an official list but the amount is ambiguous (several prices under one name), or not read from an official page. Don't ship without checking.

about.taxes: UAE VAT 5%, Saudi VAT 15%, Egypt VAT 14%, Qatar and Kuwait no VAT. App Store and apple.com prices include VAT (Apple's footnote says so for AE, SA, EG). Most service pages don't say either way; each row's note says what the page says. Netflix's help page says taxes 'may be charged in addition'.
about.serviceIds: Match src/catalog/services.data.ts ids. Local services not in the catalog (OSN+, Shahid, Anghami, STARZPLAY, TOD, Weyyak, Careem Plus, noon One, talabat pro) are in notChecked with the prices we saw, as candidates.

countries.KW: USD (Apple, Netflix, Spotify, Disney+, PlayStation all bill in USD; KWD unused)

about.method: Service pages read with curl or Playwright (chromium) from a US cloud IP using the country URL (e.g. spotify.com/ae-en/premium). App Store lists read from apps.apple.com/{cc}/app/id{ID}?l=en-GB (Apple shows at most 10 items). Pages that pick the country from the visitor's IP (youtube.com, osnplus.com, anghami.com, careem.com, noon.com, talabat.com, deezer.com) could not be read for these countries.

notChecked.apple-tv: Not sold separately in any of the 5 countries. tv.apple.com FAQ (AE, SA, EG, QA, KW): 'Apple TV isn’t sold separately in your region — it’s included in every iCloud+ plan at no extra cost.' apple.com/ae/apple-tv still has an old footnote (AED 27.99/month), ignore it. In-app: point people to iCloud+.
notChecked.apple-arcade: Included in every iCloud+ plan in all 5 countries (same tv.apple.com FAQ). Not sold separately.
notChecked.apple-one: Not offered in these markets ('Apple One is not offered in these markets, since Apple TV and Apple Arcade are already included in iCloud+'). apple.com/{ae,sa,eg,qa,kw}/apple-one redirects away.
notChecked.amazon-prime: QA, KW: no Amazon store with Prime for these countries (Amazon serves them from amazon.ae/amazon.com without a local Prime membership). Not checked further.
notChecked.prime-video: Standalone Prime Video: in AE/SA/EG it comes with Amazon Prime (rows above). In QA/KW it's sold on primevideo.com, which picks the country from the visitor's IP, and the App Store page shows no In-App Purchases list. Not checked.
notChecked.disney-plus: All 5 rows found. Catalog availableIn currently excludes these countries; add AE, SA, EG, QA, KW.
notChecked.max: HBO Max isn't on the MENA App Store (search finds no app); HBO shows stream on OSN+ in the region. Hide 'max' in these countries or alias it to OSN+.
notChecked.xbox-game-pass: EG, QA, KW: xbox.com/en-{cc}/xbox-game-pass shows 'page not found'; Game Pass isn't officially sold there.
notChecked.ps-plus: EG: playstation.com/en-eg/ps-plus returns 404; PlayStation Store isn't official in Egypt.
notChecked.google-ai-pro: EG row is unverified (two prices for Pro).
notChecked.youtube-premium: AE, EG, KW unverified (several prices under one name on the App Store; the YouTube app's own page shows no In-App Purchases list in AE/SA/EG/KW, so the YouTube Music app's list was used). youtube.com/premium says 'not available in your country' to our cloud browser.
